Clinic opening hours. The clinic is open Monday to Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm and on Saturday from 9:00 am to 1:00 pm. It is closed on public holidays.
Appointment changes. Patients may reschedule up to 24 hours before their appointment by calling reception. Reception records every change in the booking system.
Records requests. A patient may ask in writing for a copy of their records. The data protection officer logs the request and responds within 14 days.
Consent and confidentiality. Patient consent is recorded at registration. Staff may open patient identifiers only when their role requires it.
Test results. Results are shared with the patient by the treating clinician. Reception staff do not discuss test results.
Payments. The clinic accepts cash, M-Pesa and card. An invoice is issued after each visit.
